install.title: Install Gossip
install.subtitle: Available on all platforms with unified MLS end-to-end encryption
install.apkDesc: Full standalone version with 24/7 background socket, native Bluetooth Mesh radio bridge, and local SQLCipher vault.
install.desktopDesc: Runs instantly in any modern browser on Windows, macOS, and Linux with one-click desktop installation.
install.pwaDesc: Add Gossip to your smartphone home screen for fullscreen mode and offline caching:
install.iosStep1: Open this page in the Safari browser.
install.iosStep2: Tap the 'Share' button in the bottom bar.
install.androidStep1: Open the browser menu (three dots in the corner).
install.androidStep2: Tap 'Install app' or 'Add to Home screen'.
install.androidStep3: Confirm installation in the popup dialog.
install.androidStep4: Or download the native APK above for full BLE Mesh radio support.
